paragraphs.en: OpenRouter, but for agent tools instead of models. Point an agent at one base URL with one token and it can do the job: a curated catalog of thousands of endpoints across many providers — SEO and backlinks, social and trends, people and company enrichment, ads, scraping, image and video generation — priced per call, from a cent , with no provider signup. Plus your own team's keys, skills and CLIs, callable by every teammate's agent without the credential ever leaving the server.
paragraphs.zh: OpenRouter，但面向的是智能体工具而非模型。 让智能体指向一个基础 URL 并使用一个令牌，它就能完成工作：一个精选目录，涵盖众多提供商的数千个端点——SEO 和外链、社交与趋势、人员和公司信息增强、广告、抓取、图像与视频生成——按调用计费，每次调用仅一美分起，且无需在提供商处注册。 此外还有你自己团队的密钥、技能和命令行工具，团队每个成员的智能体都可以调用，而凭据绝不会离开服务器。

paragraphs.en: The tools an agent needs for real work sit behind subscriptions nobody buys for a single run — Semrush $139/mo, Moz $99/mo, Crunchbase $99/mo, Apollo $59/seat — behind signup walls, or behind no public API at all (invite-only, partner-only, app-review-only). treg carries those accounts and bills fractions of a cent per call.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体要真正干活所需的工具，都藏在没人会为单次运行而购买的订阅墙后面——Semrush 每月 139 美元、Moz 每月 99 美元、Crunchbase 每月 99 美元、Apollo 每席位 59 美元——或是藏在注册墙后面，或是根本没有公开 API（仅限邀请、仅限合作伙伴、仅限应用审核通过者）。treg 代持这些账号，并按每次调用收取极低的费用（不足一美分的零头）。

paragraphs.en: The one rule: the proxy relays, never models the upstream, and injects auth server-side — so it survives upstream API changes and callers never hold keys.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一的规则：代理只做转发，从不建模上游，并在服务端注入认证——因此它能经受住上游 API 的变化，调用方也永远不持有密钥。

paragraphs.en: Visit treg.to (hosted on Render) — the dashboard, sign-in, and every URL below live there.
paragraphs.zh: 访问 treg.to（托管在 Render 上）——仪表盘、登录页面以及下方的每个 URL 都在该站点上。

一次已编目的调用是如何被服务的——凭证阶梯，按顺序如下：

paragraphs.en: The anonymous price assumes the caller does not send a provider credential header. The faithful relay preserves caller headers, so a caller-supplied provider key can use that key's credits. Your own credential always beats treg's, so connecting a key you already pay for makes those calls free of the balance rather than duplicating them. An endpoint treg has no published price for is refused , not served free — you are told to connect your own key instead. Where several providers serve one capability, treg catalog search shows them side by side with prices; choosing is yours — treg does not silently pick or fail over between providers for you. (When treg's own account for a provider is out it may serve the same endpoint through a treg-owned relay account, disclosed on the response; a team can opt out.) The exception you opt into: treg.<capability> routed endpoints, where treg picks the provider for you and names it. For common jobs (scraping a page, web search, Google results, finding an email) start with the routed endpoint, such as treg.web.extract or treg.web.search , rather than a provider you remember by name. On treg.people.email.find and treg.people.phone.find , X-Treg-Route-Verify: true also checks the found address or number in the same call, as its own charge, and says what the check found.
paragraphs.zh: 匿名价格假定调用方不发送提供商凭据请求头。 忠实中继会保留调用方的请求头，因此调用方提供的提供商密钥可以使用该密钥的额度。 你自己的凭据始终优先于 treg 的凭据，因此接入一个你已经在付费的密钥，会使这些调用不计入余额，而不是重复扣费。 对于 treg 没有公布价格的端点，请求会被拒绝，而不是免费提供——系统会提示你改为接入自己的密钥。 当多个提供商提供同一能力时，treg 目录搜索会连同价格并排展示它们；选择权在你——treg 不会在提供商之间替你默默挑选或自动切换。 （当 treg 自身在某提供商处的账户耗尽时，它可能通过一个 treg 自有的中继账户提供相同端点，并在响应中予以披露；团队可以选择退出。）你可以主动选择加入的例外是：treg.<capability> 路由端点，treg 会替你选择提供商并指明其名称。 对于常见任务（抓取网页、网页搜索、Google 结果、查找电子邮件），应从路由端点入手，例如 treg.web.extract 或 treg.web.search，而不是凭记忆指定某个提供商。 在 treg.people.email.find 和 treg.people.phone.find 上，X-Treg-Route-Verify: true 还会在同一次调用中检查所找到的地址或号码，作为单独一项收费，并说明检查的结果。

paragraphs.en: The zero-thought path — point treg at a project and it figures out what's shareable:
paragraphs.zh: 零思考路径——将 treg 指向一个项目，它就会自动判断哪些内容可以分享：

paragraphs.en: treg scan # read-only preview: the keys, skills & CLIs upload would register treg upload # register them (encrypted server-side); idempotent, --replace to update treg upload scans the .env (matching keys against ~80 known providers), every skill subdirectory, and installed catalog CLIs. Three kinds of things go into the registry — here's how to share and use each:
paragraphs.zh: treg scan # 只读预览：将上传的密钥、技能与 CLI 注册 treg upload # 注册它们（服务端加密存储）；操作幂等，使用 --replace 更新 treg upload 会扫描 .env（将密钥与约 80 个已知服务商进行匹配）、每个技能子目录以及已安装目录中的 CLI。 有三类内容会进入注册表——下面分别介绍如何共享和使用每一类：

sents.en: treg scan # read-only preview: the keys, skills & CLIs upload would register treg upload # register them (encrypted server-side); idempotent, --replace to update treg upload scans the .env (matching keys against ~80 known providers), every skill subdirectory, and installed catalog CLIs.
sents.zh: treg scan # 只读预览：将上传的密钥、技能与 CLI 注册 treg upload # 注册它们（服务端加密存储）；操作幂等，使用 --replace 更新 treg upload 会扫描 .env（将密钥与约 80 个已知服务商进行匹配）、每个技能子目录以及已安装目录中的 CLI。

sents.en: Three kinds of things go into the registry — here's how to share and use each:
sents.zh: 有三类内容会进入注册表——下面分别介绍如何共享和使用每一类：

paragraphs.en: Share — one upstream URL callable with a stored key, or bulk from a .env :
paragraphs.zh: 共享 —— 可通过存储的密钥调用一个上游 URL，或通过 .env 进行批量调用：

paragraphs.en: treg secret add STRIPE_KEY --value sk_live_123 treg add stripe --base-url https://api.stripe.com --secret STRIPE_KEY treg upload env --select openai,stripe,resend # or straight from the .env Use — the agent-native way: build the real upstream request and prefix it with the proxy. treg resolves the tool by host, injects the credential, and relays everything else faithfully (your X-Treg-Token is stripped before the upstream sees it):
paragraphs.zh:
```
treg secret add STRIPE_KEY --value sk_live_123
treg add stripe --base-url https://api.stripe.com --secret STRIPE_KEY
treg upload env --select openai,stripe,resend
# 或者直接从 .env 文件读取
```

用法 —— 智能体原生方式：构建真实的上游请求，并在前面加上代理前缀。treg 根据主机名解析工具，注入凭据，并如实转发其余所有内容（你的 X-Treg-Token 会在上游看到之前被剥离）：

paragraphs.en: Real request: GET https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5 Through treg: GET https://treg.to/call/https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5 header: X-Treg-Token: <your token> Or the CLI shorthand — and treg calls for the audit log:
paragraphs.zh:
真实请求：GET https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5
通过 treg：GET https://treg.to/call/https://api.intercom.io/conversations?per_page=5
header：X-Treg-Token: <your token>
或者 CLI 简写——treg 会调用审计日志：

paragraphs.en: treg call intercom conversations --query per_page=5 treg call stripe v1/balance 2. CLIs Share — automatic: treg upload detects installed catalog CLIs ( stripe , gh , vercel , …) and registers them; a recipe-only catalog CLI skill (e.g. stripe-cli ) auto-becomes runnable too.
paragraphs.zh: treg call intercom conversations --query per_page=5；treg call stripe v1/balance 2。 CLI 共享 — 自动完成：treg upload 会检测已安装的目录 CLI（stripe、gh、vercel 等）并注册它们；仅有配方的目录 CLI 技能（例如 stripe-cli）也会自动变为可运行。

sents.en: treg call intercom conversations --query per_page=5 treg call stripe v1/balance 2.
sents.zh: treg call intercom conversations --query per_page=5；treg call stripe v1/balance 2。

sents.en: CLIs Share — automatic: treg upload detects installed catalog CLIs ( stripe , gh , vercel , …) and registers them; a recipe-only catalog CLI skill (e.g. stripe-cli ) auto-becomes runnable too.
sents.zh: CLI 共享 — 自动完成：treg upload 会检测已安装的目录 CLI（stripe、gh、vercel 等）并注册它们；仅有配方的目录 CLI 技能（例如 stripe-cli）也会自动变为可运行。

paragraphs.en: Use — treg run executes the vendor CLI with the org's credential injected , so you never hold the key or log in:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 — treg run 在注入组织凭证的情况下执行厂商 CLI，因此你无需持有密钥或登录：

paragraphs.en: treg run stripe -- get /v1/balance treg run gh -- pr list --local (default) runs on your machine. Server-side CLI execution ( --server ) is disabled globally. For a whole session, treg shell start opens a subshell where every registered CLI injects automatically — just use stripe , gh , … normally; exit reverts. treg runs is the audit log.
paragraphs.zh: treg run stripe -- get /v1/balance treg run gh -- pr list --local（默认）在你的机器上运行。 服务端 CLI 执行（ --server ）已在全局禁用。 对于整个会话，treg shell start 会打开一个子 shell，其中每个已注册的 CLI 都会自动注入——只需像平常一样使用 stripe 、 gh 等；退出后即恢复原状。treg runs 是审计日志。

sents.en: treg run stripe -- get /v1/balance treg run gh -- pr list --local (default) runs on your machine.
sents.zh: treg run stripe -- get /v1/balance treg run gh -- pr list --local（默认）在你的机器上运行。

sents.en: Server-side CLI execution ( --server ) is disabled globally.
sents.zh: 服务端 CLI 执行（ --server ）已在全局禁用。

sents.en: For a whole session, treg shell start opens a subshell where every registered CLI injects automatically — just use stripe , gh , … normally; exit reverts. treg runs is the audit log.
sents.zh: 对于整个会话，treg shell start 会打开一个子 shell，其中每个已注册的 CLI 都会自动注入——只需像平常一样使用 stripe 、 gh 等；退出后即恢复原状。treg runs 是审计日志。

paragraphs.en: Share — a skill is a whole capability ( SKILL.md recipe + its secrets + its tool(s)), registered together so the whole team runs the same skill, maintained in one place:
paragraphs.zh: 分享 — 技能是一个完整的能力（SKILL.md 配方 + 其密钥 + 其工具），注册在一起，使整个团队运行同一技能，并在一处进行维护：

paragraphs.en: treg upload skills --dir ~ /.claude/skills --all # register a folder of skills in one pass Use — pull any shared skill into your agent; its API calls go through treg with your token, so the key stays on the server, never in the skill:
paragraphs.zh: treg upload skills --dir ~/.claude/skills --all # 一次性注册一个技能文件夹 使用 — 将任意共享技能拉取到你的智能体中；其 API 调用会通过 treg 并使用你的令牌，因此密钥保存在服务器上，绝不会出现在技能中：

paragraphs.en: treg skill install seo-blog-writer # writes into ./.claude/skills/ (--all for the library) Manual registration — when the heuristics can't figure a tool out # multi-credential tool (e.g. google-ads: OAuth bearer + a developer-token header) treg tool add google-ads --base-url https://googleads.googleapis.com \ --bind " secret=<oauth-id>,injector=oauth " \ --bind " secret=<dev-id>,name=developer-token,format={secret} " # one skill, step by step treg skill init --dir ./my-skill # drafts treg.json (guesses base_url, finds secrets) treg skill add --dir ./my-skill # registers recipe + secrets + tool, atomically # OAuth via the browser (mints the first token, treg holds it and auto-refreshes) treg oauth connect gsc --client-secret client_secret.json \ --scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly Full options for every command: USAGE.md .
paragraphs.zh: treg skill install seo-blog-writer # 写入 ./.claude/skills/（--all 表示整个库）手动注册 — 当启发式规则无法识别某个工具时 # 多凭证工具（例如 google-ads：OAuth bearer + developer-token 请求头） treg tool add google-ads --base-url https://googleads.googleapis.com \ --bind " secret=<oauth-id>,injector=oauth " \ --bind " secret=<dev-id>,name=developer-token,format={secret} " # 一个技能，逐步操作 treg skill init --dir ./my-skill # 生成 treg.json 草稿（猜测 base_url，查找密钥） treg skill add --dir ./my-skill # 原子化注册配方 + 密钥 + 工具 # 通过浏览器进行 OAuth（生成首个令牌，treg 保存并自动刷新） treg oauth connect gsc --client-secret client_secret.json \ --scopes https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters.readonly 每个命令的完整选项：USAGE.md 。

paragraphs.en: The CLI sends anonymous command usage to PostHog when using treg.to (no arguments or credentials). Disable with TREG_TELEMETRY=0 or DO_NOT_TRACK=1 . See analytics details .
paragraphs.zh: 当使用 treg.to（不带参数或凭据）时，CLI 会向 PostHog 发送匿名的命令使用情况数据。 可通过设置 TREG_TELEMETRY=0 或 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 来禁用。详情请参阅分析说明。

WorkOS connects the company's identity provider; owners can invite their IT admin to finish setup. scripts/dev-local.sh up # 服务器运行在 http://localhost:18790，开发安全配置

paragraphs.en: Request flow for /call : resolve tool (by URL host + longest base_url prefix, or by name) → decrypt its secret(s) → apply each binding's injector → stream to the upstream → fire-and-forget audit record. The infra relay streams bytes without business logic. The call application buffers responses needing settlement or ownership evidence up to 8 MiB; larger responses return a 502 without charging instead of a truncated success. Endpoints that inline media (Gemini images) declare spooled_response : their metered answer is read to a temp file instead, settled from its reported usage, and relayed whole. Authorized free final downloads needing no body evidence stream in full, as do own-key and own-tool responses.
paragraphs.zh: /call 的请求流程：解析工具（按 URL 主机 + 最长的 base_url 前缀，或按名称）→ 解密其密钥 → 应用每个绑定的注入器 → 流式转发到上游 → 异步写入审计记录（不等待完成）。 基础设施中继只流式传输字节，不包含业务逻辑。 call 应用会把需要结算或所有权凭证的响应缓冲至 8 MiB；更大的响应将返回 502 且不收费，而不是返回被截断的成功响应。 内联媒体的端点（Gemini 图像）声明了 spooled_response：其计量的应答会被读取到临时文件，依据其报告的用量进行结算，然后整体转发。 无需响应体凭证的经授权免费最终下载会完整流式传输，自有密钥和自有工具的响应也是如此。

paragraphs.en: The 4 auth shapes (per binding injector ): env (plain string / API key) · secret_file (a JSON token file, pull a field) · oauth (a JSON OAuth token, auto-refreshed if refreshable) · cli_auth (material lifted from a CLI's keychain).
paragraphs.zh: 4 种认证形态（每个绑定注入器）：env（普通字符串 / API 密钥）· secret_file（JSON 令牌文件，提取某个字段）· oauth（JSON OAuth 令牌，可刷新时自动刷新）· cli_auth（从 CLI 钥匙串提取的凭据材料）。

paragraphs.en: Faithful-relay contract: the proxy alters only three things, everything else is verbatim:
paragraphs.zh: 忠实转发契约：代理只改动三处内容，其余逐字保留：

paragraphs.en: OAuth, three ways to get the first token: manual upload (drop in a token.json ) · auto-refresh (if the token carries refresh_token + client creds, treg keeps it fresh, you never re-upload) · hosted connect flow ( treg oauth connect → browser consent → treg captures the token itself).
paragraphs.zh: OAuth，获取首个令牌的三种方式：手动上传（放入一个 token.json）· 自动刷新（如果令牌携带 refresh_token + 客户端凭据，treg 会保持其最新状态，你无需再次上传）· 托管连接流程（treg oauth connect → 浏览器授权同意 → treg 自行捕获令牌）。

paragraphs.en: Health checks: give a tool an optional probe ( {method, path, expect_status} ); a periodic run (on demand or via cron) validates every credential, refreshes OAuth, and webhooks the owner of any that break.
paragraphs.zh: 健康检查：为工具提供一个可选的探针（{method, path, expect_status}）；定期运行（按需或通过 cron）验证每个凭据、刷新 OAuth，并通过 Webhook 通知任何出现故障的凭据的所有者。

paragraphs.en: For a restricted customer agent, treg org agent-new bot --pin customer=cust_A enforces attribution and scopes call/run history, archived results and shared-provider async ownership to that pin. Foreign or unattributed ids return 404; an unpinned operator keeps the org-wide view and shared balance. BYOK account access and public media URLs retain their existing permissions. See the multi-tenancy contract for multiple pins, migration and replay behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 对于受限的客户智能体，treg org agent-new bot --pin customer=cust_A 会强制执行归属约束，并将调用/运行历史、归档结果以及共享提供方的异步所有权都限定在该 pin 的范围内。 外部或未归属的 id 会返回 404；未加 pin 的操作员则保留组织范围的视图和共享余额。 BYOK 账户访问权限和公开媒体 URL 保留其现有权限。 多个 pin、迁移和重放行为请参阅多租户契约。
